entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: ACM SIGGRAPH
entities.note: A special interest group of the ACM that co-sponsors the annual Web3D Conference.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: An open consortium creating advanced interoperability standards like glTF, frequently collaborating with the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: AOUSD
entities.note: The Alliance for OpenUSD, an organization standardizing the Universal Scene Description framework.

entities.name: Metaverse Standards Forum
entities.note: A venue for cooperation between standards organizations and companies to foster interoperability.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D Graphics standard, heavily featured in recent Web3D conferences.

entities.name: glTF
entities.note: A 3D file format standard by Khronos, integrated into X3D 4.0.

entities.name: WebXR
entities.note: A W3C API for accessing VR and AR devices, commonly discussed alongside X3D at events.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: The annual international conference on 3D web technology.

entities.name: Web3D 2024
entities.note: The 29th International Conference on 3D Web Technology, held in Guimarães, Portugal.

entities.name: Web3D 2023
entities.note: The 28th International Conference on 3D Web Technology, held in San Sebastian, Spain.

entities.name: Web3D 2022
entities.note: The 27th International Conference on 3D Web Technology, held in Evry-Courcouronnes, France.

entities.name: Web3D 2021
entities.note: The 26th International Conference on 3D Web Technology, held virtually.

entities.name: Web3D 2020
entities.note: The 25th International Conference on 3D Web Technology, held virtually and hosted by the Web3D Korea Chapter.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH
entities.note: The premier annual computer graphics conference hosted by ACM SIGGRAPH.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH Asia
entities.note: The annual Asian counterpart to the SIGGRAPH computer graphics conference.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH Web3D BOF
entities.note: An annual Birds of a Feather session at SIGGRAPH dedicated to Web3D and X3D updates.

entities.name: Khronos 3D Commerce BOF
entities.note: A session at SIGGRAPH where Khronos and partners discuss 3D commerce standards.

entities.name: WebXR Summit
entities.note: An event focusing on WebXR technologies where X3D integration is often discussed.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key architect of X3D and frequent presenter at Web3D events.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: President of the Web3D Consortium and regular speaker at the Web3D Conference.

entities.name: Anita Havele
entities.note: Executive Director of the Web3D Consortium, organizing community events.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: Creator of the Castle Game Engine and active participant in Web3D conferences.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: The core group within the Web3D Consortium responsible for the X3D standard.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D working group focusing on medical applications of X3D.

entities.name: Heritage Working Group
entities.note: A Web3D working group focusing on cultural heritage preservation using X3D.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source JavaScript framework integrating X3D into HTML5, often presented at Web3D events.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A standard-compliant WebGL X3D player frequently updated and showcased at Web3D conferences.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: An open-source X3D authoring tool maintained by the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Web3D Korea Chapter
entities.note: A regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium that hosted Web3D 2020.
